name: Blast Wave
desc: A shock tube with no way out — detonations bloom into circular blast fronts that steepen until they stand vertical, slam into the walls and fork into Mach stems hinged at a travelling triple point, then run each other down and collide, because in a compressible gas a wave's own amplitude sets its speed and nothing passes through anything unchanged; as a false-color CFD pressure plate, a supersonic Mach-number map, density interferometry, a sumi ink blast, or spectral false-color.

energy.doc: detonation strength — the pressure ratio of the hot spot, plus exposure and shock contrast (the master knob)

scale.doc: charge size — from pinpoint cracks to blasts that fill a third of the box

speed.doc: simulation rate (the CFL condition still governs stability — this only sets pacing)

density.doc: detonation rate — how many blasts are ringing around the box at once

stiff.doc: adiabatic index gamma — how hard the gas resists compression: low gives thin dense shells and violent fronts, high gives soft fat rolling waves

hue.doc: hue of the high-pressure end of the ramp

x.doc: center of the detonation zone across the box

y.doc: center of the detonation zone down the box

style.doc: aesthetic: false-color CFD log-pressure plate / abstracted Mach-number map where only supersonic gas lights / density interferometry / sumi ink blast on paper / spectral false-color

seed.doc: deterministic seed for charge placement, timing and yield
